objective: The three cheetahs and the three lions on the pipeline's rig with baked clips (decision 0133): each regenerated in a neutral stance from SHANNON's concept picks, with its family's clip set and a power attack keyed for its own spell.
acceptance_criteria: The Cheetah, the Lightning Cheetah and the Thunder Cheetah play the cheetah set: a stalking walk, and Wind blades, Tail bolt and Thunderhead for their spells (the two swipes at 0.5 and 0.7 s, the tail's whip at 0.9, the storm's stamp at 0.92)
The Lion, the Sun Lion and the Shadow Lion play the lion set: a prowling walk, and King's roar, Solar flare and Shadow claws for their spells
A model made askew is turned straight before it is measured, and a crest or cloud on its rump cannot lift its joints (autoland.py)
No clip any of the six plays stretches more than 7 % of its surface
Uploaded and seen in Studio with the build stamp
verification: (filled in after the upload and the Studio check)
notes: Same asset names, so species entries, spells, coats and drops are unchanged; the previous uploads are left for archiving by hand. Scope: the pipeline's autoland.py (straightening, the joint cap, no automatic turn-round) and the two families' power clips ride in this PR. The Thunder Cheetah is the asset of the species id fire_cheetah (StationRules.FORGE). Scope: Clips/init.luau looks for a model's bones twice a second instead of every frame until they arrive, and warns once if one never does (the Lightning Cheetah's second tail bone carried no skin, Roblox dropped it on import, and the model stood unanimated; export_game.py now leaves such bones out).
